s0DB224.name: Level objects: midway/goal gate, coins
summary: Three object routines in one section: the midway/goal gate (3 columns of top/middle/bottom tiles; type 0 = midway, else goal),
the Yoshi coin (2 tiles, skipped when item memory says it was collected) and the blue coin rectangle (tile $2C, skipping collected ones).
Parameters: [$57] = level position index, [$59] = size/type byte, writes Map16 tiles through the pointer at [$6B].

s0DB3BD.name: Level object: rope/cloud row
summary: Places a horizontal run of tiles; type (high nibble of [$59]) picks $05 or $06, width is the low nibble.

s0DB3DB.name: Map16 tiles: water/lava/net surfaces
summary: Top-row tiles ($00,$01,$04,$08) then lower-row tiles ($02,$03,$05,$0B), indexed by object number - $17.

s0DB3E3.name: Level object: water/lava/net-top surface
summary: Draws a rectangle: top row from the top table, remaining rows from the lower-row table. Type = object number - $17.

s0DB42B.name: Map16 tiles: donut bridge
summary: Top $26, bottom $44.

s0DB42D.name: Level objects: donut bridge, net bottom edge
summary: Donut bridge: two rows, top tile $26 then bottom tile $44, width from the low nibble of [$59]. Net bottom edge: rows of tile $0B with a last row of $0E.

s0DB49E.name: Level object: net vertical edge
summary: Draws a column of tile $0A or $0C, merging with existing net tiles at the top and bottom via the two helpers below.

s0DB4D5.name: Map16 tiles: net edge merge (top helper)
summary: Replacement tiles when overlapping an existing net edge: $07,$09 over a top edge, $1A,$19 over a bottom edge.

s0DB4D9.name: Net edge: merge top tile with existing tile
summary: Writes [A] unless the tile already at the pointer is $08 (net top edge) or $0E (net bottom edge), in which case a junction tile from the table is used.

s0DB4FA.name: Map16 tiles: net edge merge (bottom helper)
summary: Replacement tiles over a bottom edge: $0D,$0F; over a top edge: $1C,$1B.

s0DB4FE.name: Net edge: merge bottom tile; bone/pipe/log objects
summary: Merge helper for the last tile of the vertical net edge, followed by the vertical (tiles $53-$55) and horizontal (tiles $56-$58) bone/pipe/log objects.

s0DB571.name: Level object: single cloud fringe block
summary: Places one tile from the table for objects $68-$6F.

s0DB5A8.name: Map16 tiles: bushes (left/middle/right)
summary: Left, middle and right tiles for bush types 0-4.

s0DB5B7.name: Level object: bushes 1-5 (and switch blocks)
summary: Contains the yellow/green switch block objects (outline tile if unpressed, solid tile if pressed, tiles $6A/$6B), then draws a bush of the chosen type: left tile, middle tiles, right tile.

s0DB5E8.name: Map16 tiles: arch ledge
summary: Four rows of 7 bytes: left (3 tiles), middle (3 tiles, repeated), right (1 tile). Row 0 is the top surface.

s0DB604.name: Level object: arch ledge
summary: Draws 4 rows using the table above, repeating the 3-tile middle pattern width times; one routine per map16 page variant.

s0DB6C1.name: Map16 tiles: top cloud fringe types

s0DB6C3.name: Level object: top cloud fringe
summary: Horizontal run of tile $93 or $9C (type), length from the low nibble.

s0DB6E3.name: Level object: tree branch
summary: Places one tile, $C1 or $C2, for object numbers $88-$89.

s0DB6F5.name: Map16 tiles: left/right cloud fringe
summary: Top and middle tile tables, 8 types each.

s0DB705.name: Level object: left/right cloud fringe
summary: Vertical column: a top tile then middle tiles; height in high nibble, type in low nibble.

s0DB72F.name: Map16 tiles: right-facing diagonal pipe
summary: Tile rows of 2, 4, 5 and 5 tiles; the drawing routine follows in the next chunk.
